Steps for welfare walks at the skyport
The desk wrote this for returning guests
Companion Animal Travel Desk welfare walk guidance

At Aurelia Skyways, we keep pet movement calm, careful, and easy to follow. This note helps travelers prepare for welfare walks at the skyport so the experience stays steady for both guest and animal.

Please keep your pet close, use a secure lead or carrier, and move at a pace that feels settled for the animal. The lounge staff may point you toward the quiet path, the relief area, or a waiting spot if the space is busy. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and the service treats each journey as a shared responsibility.

If you are bringing a rabbit, keep the health certificate with your travel papers and present it when asked. <<FACT F082>> If you are using a crate for a rabbit, make sure it is sturdy, well ventilated, and roomy enough for a calm posture. <<FACT F070>>

Before the walk, check that food, water, bedding, and any needed supplies are packed in an easy-to-reach bag. During the walk, avoid sudden stops, loud voices, and crowded aisles. If your pet shows stress, pause in a quieter area and let the animal settle before continuing. Travelers like Naomi Nguyen, Felix Berg, and Harley the pet are all handled with the same steady care.

If you need help with routing, paperwork, or pet-handling support, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at the skyport for prompt assistance.
